results.content: The latest Quinnipiac University showed Trump's approval rating at 32%, while 58% of respondents said they disapproved of the president's job performance. According to the pollster, Trump’s performance in the poll is the worst recorded in either of his terms in the White House. Nearly half the voters surveyed also said they are "worse off financially" then they were one year ago and 88% said they feel inflation is a very serious or somewhat serious problem. This page compares overall trends in opinion polling averages during the first and second terms of Donald Trump's (R) presidency. Ballotpedia's polling indexes are an average of polls that measure public sentiment on presidential job approval, congressional job approval, and satisfaction with the overall direction of the country.
